name: Boxing Day Blues
from: Concept 2: a day in a future streamlined by AI networks, where a citizen nearly reaches a human connection and fails.
hook: Everyone says “Happy Boxing Day.” Nobody knows what the box was.
pitch: One day in a future run smoothly by AI networks. You have until evening to reach one person, using phrases the system offers whose meanings have worn away. You will almost manage it.
minute_check: Yes, from the title line alone.
build_check: Yes: four scenes and a phrase list.
scope: One day, four scenes. The phrase list is your main asset; write it first.

brief.player: A citizen of the far future, over one day.
brief.goal: Reach another person: one real conversation by the end of the day.
brief.fail: The day ends before you get there (the expected outcome).
brief.ending: You almost connect. The phrase "Boxing Day blues" is said by someone who no longer knows what it meant.
brief.verb: Choose what to say, from phrases the system offers.
brief.theme: When culture is lost it is not easily regained. The dialogue options are fragments whose meaning is gone.
brief.look: Minimal start screen; one press and you are in.

prov.bug: Say the phrase! Everybody says it.
prov.nit: Does anyone in the game remember what it meant? Who could the player learn it from?

refs_lit: Ray Bradbury, “There Will Come Soft Rains” (1950)
An automated house carries on its routines after the people are gone.
A day-by-day game about reaching people in a town that is running down.
A machine learning human culture from fragments (an old musical), which the humans have forgotten.
omni_gameplay_prompt: Minimalist melancholic side-view narrative game in soft twilight lavender (#e9e6f2), deep plum silhouettes (#2b2740), and muted violet (#8f6cd9). Gentle slow-panning side camera across a quiet futuristic transit platform at dusk. Two stylized silhouette citizens pause near each other as soft glowing speech-bubble glyphs float upward between them, almost harmonizing in color before drifting apart into the evening snow as a transit train glides past. Continuous unbroken gameplay shot, no scene cuts, no gibberish text. Use the reference image for pastel dusk palette and minimalist staging. Sound design: gentle winter wind, soft electric piano chords, distant chime. No dialogue.
